warnings: Simple rectangular 4 x 4 grid, no dummy grids needed at foundation level. x spacings 4.00 / 5.00 / 4.00 sum to the printed 13.00 m; y spacings 2.00 / 4.00 / 5.00 sum to the printed 11.00 m -- both chains close exactly against their printed overall dimension.

This drawing set is CAD-drawn (2562/2019) and far cleaner than house 06's 2546 scan. NO break lines are used on S-02 -- the whole building fits at 1:100. That was the trap that caused a wrong grid decision on house 06, so it was checked for explicitly here and is absent.
Grid A is the SOUTH/bottom edge and carries only a partial row of footings; the building footprint is not a full 4 x 4 rectangle of columns (see the S-02 plan file).

The 1.20 / 0.80 sub-chain printed between grids A and B on the left, and the 1.60 dimension at the bottom right, locate off-grid footings F1 rather than defining new grid lines -- they are dimensions to isolated pad centres, not column lines, so no dummy grid was created for them.
Only ONE building in this set (unlike house 06's main block plus toilet block), so a single grid master covers everything.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: x_lines/y_lines moved from top level into a nested grid{} object, matching the reviewed convention in houses 01-05 (สิ่งที่ต้องแก้ item 35). Key order and every entry's content are byte-identical, only the nesting level changed.

2026-08-24 §4-upgrade: z_levels[] derived from this house's human-reviewed per-page extractions (element_type level/datum with level_m), deduplicated by (label, level_m) — not a fresh image sweep; source_image on each entry names the reviewed file's page

2026-08-24 §4-upgrade: dimension_chains[]/unassigned_dimensions[] deliberately ABSENT — they require a page-by-page image transcription sweep (§4 2026-08-21) that has not been done for this house; absence means not-yet-swept, per spec. Do not backfill them from resolved pos_m values.
